title: arXiv Recent Papers Across Quant Categories
description: Snapshots recently submitted papers from arXiv across the most market-relevant quant categories: cs.AI (artificial intelligence), cs.LG (machine learning), cs.CL (computational linguistics, NLP), cs.CR (cryptography), cs.NE (neural networks), q-fin.CP (computational finance), q-fin.MF (mathematical finance), q-fin.PM (portfolio management), q-bio.QM (quantitative methods), and stat.ML (machine learning statistics). Each row identifies a paper with arxiv_id, title, abstract excerpt, primary category, all categories, author count, published / updated dates, and URL. Powers the Science & Forecasting Community Brief: novel research in AI / cryptography / quant-finance / quant-biology often signals capability shifts that move themed equities (NVDA / SOXX on AI papers; BIIB / VRTX on q-bio; algo trading firms on q-fin.PM). Free arXiv API, no auth.

import pandas as pd
import requests
from bs4 import BeautifulSoup
from datetime import datetime, timezone

now = datetime.now(timezone.utc)
now_epoch = int(now.timestamp())

BASE = 'https://export.arxiv.org/api/query'

EXPECTED_COLUMNS = [
    'arxiv_id', 'title', 'abstract',
    'primary_category', 'all_categories',
    'author_count', 'first_author',
    'published_date', 'updated_date',
    'comment', 'doi', 'page_url', '_epoch',
]

CATEGORIES = [
    'cs.AI', 'cs.LG', 'cs.CL', 'cs.CR', 'cs.NE',
    'q-fin.CP', 'q-fin.MF', 'q-fin.PM',
    'q-bio.QM', 'stat.ML',
]

rows = []
seen_ids = set()
for ci in range(len(CATEGORIES)):
    cat = CATEGORIES[ci]
    try:
        resp = requests.get(
            BASE,
            params={
                'search_query': 'cat:' + cat,
                'start': 0,
                'max_results': 30,
                'sortBy': 'submittedDate',
                'sortOrder': 'descending',
            },
            timeout=30,
        )
        resp.raise_for_status()
        text_body = resp.text
    except Exception:
        continue
    if not text_body:
        continue
    try:
        soup = BeautifulSoup(text_body, 'xml')
        entries = soup.find_all('entry')
    except Exception:
        continue
    if not entries:
        continue
    for ei in range(len(entries)):
        entry = entries[ei]
        id_tag = entry.find('id')
        full_id = id_tag.text.strip() if id_tag and id_tag.text else ''
        arxiv_id = full_id.split('/')[-1] if full_id else ''
        if not arxiv_id:
            continue
        if arxiv_id in seen_ids:
            continue
        seen_ids.add(arxiv_id)
        title_tag = entry.find('title')
        title = title_tag.text.strip().replace('\n', ' ') if title_tag and title_tag.text else ''
        summary_tag = entry.find('summary')
        abstract = summary_tag.text.strip().replace('\n', ' ') if summary_tag and summary_tag.text else ''
        if len(abstract) > 1500:
            abstract = abstract[:1500] + '...'
        primary_cat_tag = entry.find('arxiv:primary_category')
        primary_category = ''
        if primary_cat_tag:
            primary_category = primary_cat_tag.get('term', '') or ''
        if not primary_category:
            primary_category = cat
        category_tags = entry.find_all('category')
        cat_terms = []
        if category_tags:
            for cti in range(len(category_tags)):
                ct = category_tags[cti]
                term = ct.get('term', '') or ''
                if term and term not in cat_terms:
                    cat_terms.append(term)
        all_cats_str = '; '.join(cat_terms[:6])
        author_tags = entry.find_all('author')
        first_author = ''
        author_count = 0
        if author_tags:
            author_count = len(author_tags)
            first_a_name = author_tags[0].find('name') if author_tags[0] else None
            if first_a_name and first_a_name.text:
                first_author = first_a_name.text.strip()
        published_tag = entry.find('published')
        updated_tag = entry.find('updated')
        published_date = published_tag.text.strip() if published_tag and published_tag.text else ''
        updated_date = updated_tag.text.strip() if updated_tag and updated_tag.text else ''
        comment_tag = entry.find('arxiv:comment')
        comment = comment_tag.text.strip()[:300] if comment_tag and comment_tag.text else ''
        doi_tag = entry.find('arxiv:doi')
        doi = doi_tag.text.strip() if doi_tag and doi_tag.text else ''
        page_url = full_id if full_id.startswith('http') else 'https://arxiv.org/abs/' + arxiv_id
        rows.append({
            'arxiv_id': arxiv_id,
            'title': title[:300] if len(title) > 300 else title,
            'abstract': abstract,
            'primary_category': primary_category,
            'all_categories': all_cats_str,
            'author_count': author_count,
            'first_author': first_author,
            'published_date': published_date,
            'updated_date': updated_date,
            'comment': comment,
            'doi': doi,
            'page_url': page_url,
            '_epoch': now_epoch,
        })

if rows:
    df = pd.DataFrame(rows, columns=EXPECTED_COLUMNS)
    df = df.sort_values('updated_date', ascending=False).reset_index(drop=True)
else:
    df = pd.DataFrame(columns=EXPECTED_COLUMNS)

GENERATE_RESULTS(df)
